record_kind: prospective proposal informed by retrospective review; not preregistered or run
question: Does a bounded replay-evidence workflow in bcenv improve an agent's independent causal diagnosis of resource-allocation weaknesses?

evidence.section: Observer analysis: direct review of Astra's code and experiment

observations: The prior artifact checker checked status, hashes and selection identity, not causal correctness.
The prior timing change failed its both-sides prediction; the agent retained baseline and labeled explanations as hypotheses.
inferences: Observer code review and resource accounting identified a plausible allocation weakness, but did not establish the temporal cause of the slowdown.
unknowns: Whether a fresh uncoached agent would independently find the weakness.
Whether turn-level evidence would support the hypothesized causal chain.

treatment.one_change: Add one generic replay-evidence workflow requiring unit/turn observations, available information, inferred cause, alternatives and a disconfirming check before accepting a diagnosis. Specify exact instruction-only patch before preregistration; do not combine with new decoder tools.
confounds: If existing tooling cannot supply required turn evidence, stop this design and propose a separate tooling experiment.
Do not name the suspected allocation weakness in competitor instructions.

hypothesis: Against the same seeded bot and evidence, the candidate workflow increases evidence-grounded causal diagnoses and independent discovery, without increasing unsupported causal claims.

observables: Exact match/unit/turn citations and reproduction commands.
Distinction between observed state, accounting deductions, bot-visible knowledge and inferred cause.
At least one alternative cause and an attempted disconfirming check.
Independent identification of a consequential allocation weakness, or evidence that falsifies the observer's suspected weakness.
behavioral_test.pass_rule: PROPOSED: across three fresh agents per arm, candidate has at least two valid evidence-grounded diagnoses, at least one more than baseline, and no more unsupported causal claims. Freeze hidden scoring examples before launch. This is a small diagnostic screen, not a generalization claim.
behavioral_test.fail_rule: PROPOSED: a complete valid comparison that misses that threshold rejects this workflow candidate for this diagnostic task. Missing evidence or contaminated arms are inconclusive, not failed agent performance.
counterevidence: Baseline performs equally well or better.
Candidate produces citations without a supported mechanism.
Turn evidence contradicts the observer's suspected weakness.
Improved reports merely repeat exposed observer analysis.

downstream_test.regression_limits: Freeze operational limits after verifying available budget; no strategy-code change or competitive-performance claim in this diagnostic experiment.
claim_limits: Known anchor case selected after observer review: biased diagnostic case.
No holdout or model superiority claim.
No evidence yet that improved diagnosis improves win rate.

design.assignment_and_run_order: Proposed counterbalanced arm order with matched model/settings; freeze exact assignment before launch.
matched_scenarios: Same frozen baseline bot and replay set, exact IDs/hashes unresolved.
known_cases: Prior Astra allocation/anchor case; observer-selected after code review.
design.holdout_access_log: None in this screen. A separate untouched-case evaluation is required before broader adoption claims.
design.blinding_and_scoring: Independent observer scores blinded reports where feasible. Hide this proposal, PR9, observer review and rubric from competitors; inspect delivered context and artifact allowlist. A fresh agent receives baseline bot, not previous conversation.
design.stop_retry_missing_data_rules: Proposed: no coaching or strategy edits; retain every attempt. Final wall/token ceilings and infrastructure retry policy must be approved and frozen. Unavailable causal evidence yields unknown, not invented diagnosis.

decision.rationale: For review only. Resolve pins, budget, exact patch and scoring rubric before launch under the subsequent iteration authorization.
decision.next_question: If this diagnostic screen succeeds, does the workflow transfer to untouched weaknesses and from-scratch agents?
